text:
carmen: heads up — replay queue for telemetry has been backing up since last night, visible in telemetry.replay-lag dashboard. backlog ~120M events, mostly from mobile ingestion shard-7

dmitri: yikes. is it malformed events causing retries or just throughput?

carmen: mostly time-skewed events (old client clocks) + a tail of records with missing user_id that our consumer chokes on. consumer currently crashes and restarts which triggers rebalance and amplifies lag.

hao: we should push malformed -> dead-letter topic instead of crashing. can we make consumer tolerant and ack/skip?

jess: +1 on dead-letter. also we need replay throttling to avoid saturating parquet writers and S3 IO when we reprocess. wrote a quick patch to add backoff token bucket on the replay worker.

carmen: idea: two-pronged approach:
1) deploy tolerant consumer that emits bad events to telemetry.dlq
2) enqueue replay jobs at controlled rate with dedupe window and shard-aware batching
3) run small canary (shard-3) -> monitor cost/latency/duplicates

dmitri: sounds good. for (1) what's the tolerance level? drop if missing user_id and log, or attempt enrichment?

hao: simplest is drop+dlq for now. enrichment introduces external calls and will slow the consumer. we can add enrichment as a separate postprocess job that reads dlq if needed.

jess: implemented token bucket config in replay worker, default rate = 200k events/min. canary at 20% of that. code gist:
```
# pseudocode
bucket = TokenBucket(rate=200_000/60)
for rec in consumer:
  if not bucket.take(1):
    sleep(0.5)
  process(rec)
```

carmen: nice. we also need idempotency keys for recompute to avoid double-writes to aggregate window tables. use event_uuid + aggregation_window as dedupe key.

dmitri: agree. make sure the parquet writer is atomic-ish: write to tmp then move. we already do that, right?

jess: yes tmp+rename, but with high concurrency we hit eventual consistency in manifest listing. adding small jitter to commit times helps.

hao: alerting: add metric telemetry.replay.deadletter.rate and telemetry.replay.dup_rate. set SLOs: deadletter rate < 0.5% for canary, duplication < 0.2%.

carmen: created a new dashboard panel under telemetry -> Replay Ops: lag, dlq-rate, dedupe-failures, parquet-commit-ms. linked it in the incident channel.

ops-bot: Recompute DAG replay_v2 scheduled at 2026-03-20T02:00:00Z by jess (canary=shard-3) :white_check_mark:

dmitri: rollout plan:
- merge tolerant consumer (feature flag off)
- run canary by flipping flag for shard-3 and start replay_v2 at low rate
- monitor dashboard for 30m, check dedupe and dlq trends
- if green, ramp 4x every 15m until target rate
- if dlq spikes > 1% or dup_rate > 0.5% -> rollback flag + pause replays

jess: will add a console toggle in the Replay page to control global throttle and per-customer override. UX note: add a confirmation modal that shows estimated cost and affected shards.

carmen: permission check: only infra@ and oncall@ groups should toggle. add audit log entry when toggled.

hao: small compatibility note: consumer config change requires bump to kafka-client v2.4 — schedule a short maintenance window for rolling consumer upgrade to avoid protocol mismatches.

dmitri: also we should set retention for telemetry.dlq to 30d and implement a rehydration job that can reprocess dlq after manual triage.

jess: ticketed the work: ENG-telemetry-3421 (consumer tolerance + dlq), ENG-telemetry-3422 (replay token bucket + console toggle), ENG-telemetry-3423 (dashboards + alerts). linking PRs in the ticket.

carmen: timeline: aiming for canary deploy in next 6 hours assuming no blockers. tagging @oncall for visibility. :eyes:

ops-bot: @oncall notified: playback canary scheduled in 6h.

dmitri: one more thought — ensure we add metrics for parquet file size distribution. smaller files massively increase PUT ops and cost. aim for ~128MB target.

jess: will add file size histogram to the dashboard and an alert if median < 32MB for sustained 15m.

carmen: cool. I'll start the tolerant consumer PR and add dlq topic config. ping if you want to pair on the canary run. :thumbsup:

hao: thanks — I'll prepare the kafka upgrade plan and a short runbook for rollback.

jess: merging DLQ + throttling PRs to staging now. will post deploy bot ping when staged.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: staging deploy started for replay-service@staging (build 2026.3.20.1).

carmen: great. follow-up: after successful ramp we'll plan a full backfill for any remaining windowed holes but only after dlq is evaluated.

dmitri: ack. good plan.

jess: any objections to the 30% cost buffer for the first 24h of ramp? want to avoid surprises on the billing dashboard.

carmen: +1, set fiscal alert for spend > buffer.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: staging deploy completed.

carmen: thanks team — will update thread after canary results.
